title: The City That Jacked Itself Up

lines.t: A whole street of brick buildings started rising into the air. And the shops inside... stayed open.
This was Chicago. A young city built just a few feet above the water of a huge lake.
When it rained, the water had nowhere to go. The streets turned into swamps.
Digging drains under everything? Way too expensive. So the city picked a crazier plan.
Lift the entire city up. Four feet. In some places, fourteen.
One of the fanciest hotels went up inch by inch, for days, while the guests were still sleeping inside.
Then a young engineer took on half a block of a busy street.
He slid six thousand jackscrews under the buildings, and hired six hundred men.
You see, each man looked after ten jacks. On a signal, every man turned every screw... one notch.
One notch. A tiny fraction of an inch. Then again. And again. For four days.
And inside, people kept shopping like nothing was happening.
Some houses were even put on logs and rolled to a brand new street. One visitor wrote that in a single day...
Your city is sinking. A, lift the whole city. Or B, move to the hills.
